definition.primary_IC: Spearman rank correlation between predicted and actual absolute 48h endpoint log returns
definition.secondary_IC: Pearson correlation between the same raw forecast and target values
definition.primary_definition_status: Working convention stated to user; confirm if team requires Pearson instead
definition.population: Pooled time-series correlation across exactly the original 18481 BTC development origins; not a cross-asset IC or mean of monthly/fold ICs
definition.missing: Fail on nonfinite values; no row drops
definition.p_values: Not reported: overlapping 48h labels violate independent-observation inference

verification: Spearman checked as Pearson correlation of average ranks
promotion_rule: Require strictly lower same-row MAE AND strictly higher pooled Spearman IC than incumbent; retain incumbent if either fails. Pearson retained as diagnostic unless team specifies it as primary.
